title: Open Values Slate v0.1
description: A group's plan for one facts file: the options it would use, the ones it would move away from, and the sourced reason for each, worked out from the group's values. The page at /slate/ makes it.

code.description: The option's code in the facts file.

brand.description: The option's brand or maker, when the facts file gives one.

score.description: How well the option fits the group's values, from 0 to 100.

tier.description: The plain fit label for the score. The engine writes it as a pair: the label, such as "Strong fit", and a style name for drawing it. Older files may hold the label alone.

why.description: The criteria that did most to set this option's score, most important first.

reason.description: The one fact the plan gives as this option's reason: its criterion, score, band, note, and the source and date when the facts file has them.

conflicts.description: Values the group weighted 4 or more that this option scores badly on, each with its source.

label.description: The criterion's name as shown to people.

key.description: The criterion's key in the facts file.

v.description: The option's score on that criterion, from 0 to 100. It is 25 or less, which is why it counts as a conflict.

source.description: The web address of the source for that score, or empty when the facts file gives none.

note.description: The facts file's note on that score.

asof.description: When that score's claim was true, as the facts file gives it.

format.description: Always "open-values-slate". Tells a reader that this file is a group's plan.

version.description: The version of the slate format this file follows, 0.1.

lens.description: The id of the facts file the plan was built from.

lensTitle.description: The facts file's title, from its meta.

lensHash.description: A fingerprint of that facts file, so a reader can tell whether the plan was made from the file they have.

by.description: Whose values the plan uses: the name or source written in the values file that was loaded.

values.description: The group's weight for each shared value, from 0 to 5, copied from the values file the plan was made with.

applied.description: The shared values weighted 4 or more that this facts file has a criterion for, so they changed the plan.

dissent.description: What the group split on, carried from its collective file.

endorse.description: The options the group would use: up to three that score 60 or more, best first.

divest.description: The options the group would move away from: up to three that score 25 or less on a value the group weighted 4 or more, lowest overall score first.

ranked.description: Every option the facts file could score with these values, best first.
